research.name: dotLottie Web
research.note: Lottie and dotLottie player with a Rust and WASM core, switchable Software, WebGL and WebGPU renderers, and themes and color slots editable at runtime.

effects: Lottie playback from a WASM player core with a runtime switch between Software, WebGL and WebGPU renderers
named color slots and bundled themes (dark, high_contrast, deuteranopia) inside one .lottie file, editable live
playback modes (forward, reverse, bounce, reverse bounce) with segment range and frame interpolation controls
